en:
Yes, that's it!
The Virtual World is a <CLT=cltSTRONG>loop<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Loop?

Just like in old games, right!?
Like, for example...

When a character goes off the left side 
of the screen and reappears on the right.

Yes, exactly. The edges of the Virtual
World are linked together in a continuous loop.
The Virtual World...loops?
Wh-What in the world!?

If that's true, it would explain the way
the signboard was swept away.

It vanished into the wall downstream of the
river, came out of that same wall upstream...

and floated with the current until it
got caught on the rocks.

What was the world like before Miu
added the wall...?

Actually, there wasn't a wall on the Y-axis
at all, and the X-axis was set to loop.

A-Are you serious? Even if it is a computer
program, isn't that too crazy?

A looping world... That's more 
extraordinary than even magic...

But, at least it's not a boring answer. 
It also explains all the things that happened.

Huh? It doesn't explain 
everything, does it?

Cuz we still don't know why we heard 
that one sound or Keebo's voice.

Yeah, sound doesn't go past
the map loading point.

Actually, if we know that the world is a
loop, we can explain that as well.
Huh? Really?

Yes, but first we need to be clear
*where* the loop starts.
Where the loop starts...

Doesn't it loop at the walls next to
the mansion and chapel...?

Not necessarily. If we heard a noise at the
chapel from inside the mansion, then the loop...
Ah...over there.
What? Over there?

If the X-axis loops, wouldn't the loop point
be running through the world vertically?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The loop begins in the forest
west of the mansion.

Considering the position of the forest, isn't
that an odd location for the loop point to be?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe the loop is the chapel?

Wouldn't the loop point run through the whole
world, rather than be confined to one location?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe the loop is the roof of the mansion?

Wouldn't the loop point run through the whole
world, rather than be confined to one location?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe the loop is the stairs of the mansion?

Wouldn't the loop point run through the whole
world, rather than be confined to one location?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe the loop is the mansion?

Wouldn't the loop point run through the whole
world, rather than be confined to one location?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The loop begins at the river!

But nothing happened when we crossed
the river using the signboard, right?

When you cross the transition point on the
map, you can't see or hear anything...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Isn't it the wall near the mansion and chapel?
If that's wrong, please tell me why.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Where is the looping point?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>map loading point<CLT=cltNORMAL> was 
where the Virtual World looped.

We thought the <CLT=cltSTRONG>loading point<CLT=cltNORMAL> was
in the middle of the map...

But the loading point was
actually at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>edges<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So the wall Miu created wasn't at the 
edges of the world, but rather...
Her wall was at the center of the world.

I see, so the mansion and chapel were near
each other, with a wall between them...

And any sound emitted near the chapel would
also reach the mansion.

The wall <CLT=cltSTRONG>only allows non-humans to pass through<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
so <CLT=cltSTRONG>sound<CLT=cltNORMAL> should be able to pass through easily.

That's right. That's how
the Virtual World works!

Mwa-hahahahahaha!!!
Impressive, Shuichi!

For you to get this far! 
Yes! Yeeeesss! You are useful, indeed!

<CLT=cltSTRONG>"For you to get this far"<CLT=cltNORMAL>? What are you, 
some villain pulling the strings?

Nope! Miu pulled the strings here, not me.
Remember?
Miu also set this trap.
It all began when Miu showed us the map.

Because of the map, we mistakenly thought the
loading point was at the center...

Which, in turn, made the mansion and chapel
seem farther away from each other.

But the structure of the world wasn't
actually like that.

There was a wall along the Y-axis,
and the X-axis came around in a loop.

By putting that wall in the center of
that world, she cut off the loop...

So, ever since Miu showed us that map,
we were caught in her trap.

But we solved this mystery, thanks to Shuichi!
All hail our savior!

Yeah. If Shuichi wasn't here, then 
we never would've solved this mystery.
That's right! Good work, Shuichi!
Thanks, Shuichi! You saved us!
Ah... You're welcome.

Just because we found out the Virtual World's
secret, doesn't mean we can take it easy yet.

Actually...this culprit hunt just got to
the exciting part!

Even if we know all the tricks, it's pretty
meaningless if we don't find the culprit.
That's how a class trial works, after all!
Kokichi talking like Monokuma again...

Tch... No matter what you say,
I'm not gonna believe your lies...

I'm gonna believe in everyone!
That's how I'm gonna reach the truth!

Nee-heehee... 
I can't wait to see what happens next.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is Kokichi's plan here?

<CLT=cltMIND>He's definitely prodding
at Kaito on purpose.

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, there's no time
for distractions like him.

<CLT=cltMIND>What we have to do is
find the culprit who killed Miu.

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't matter how many little
mysteries we solve, if we can't find the culprit...
<CLT=cltMIND>it would all be for nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>But I still don't know
for sure who it could be.

<CLT=cltMIND>Who used Miu's own plan
against her to kill her?
<CLT=cltMIND>Who killed Miu...?
